titulo.estudio: Une nouvelle de quartier : Repérer les informations
titulo.alumno: A neighbourhood news story: Finding the details

intro: Tell apart the main event, the context and the consequences in a local news story. Read the French first; open the translation whenever you want to check your understanding.

frases.estudio: La ville a inauguré lundi une piste cyclable de quatre kilomètres entre la gare et le campus.
frases.alumno: On Monday the city opened a four-kilometre cycle lane between the station and the campus.

frases.estudio: Le chantier avait commencé au printemps, alors que la rue restait ouverte aux bus.
frases.alumno: The construction work had started in spring, while the street remained open to buses.

piezas.titulo: Key words: a neighbourhood news story

texto: Tell apart the main event, the context and the consequences in a local news story. Separate the fact from its context: verb tenses, connectors and who says what show when and by whom each piece of information is given.
Watch out: the passé composé presents events; the imparfait describes the setting, and connectors link consequences. In this passage, «chantier» means «construction work».
